WITH filtered_behavior AS (
  SELECT ab.translink
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149
),
matched_records AS (
  SELECT fb.translink, tr.ordertypedist
  FROM filtered_behavior fb
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = fb.translink
  WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    translink,
    ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM matched_records
  GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist
),
type_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    SUM(count)::NUMERIC as total_count
  FROM group_counts
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  gc.translink,
  gc.ordertypedist,
  gc.count,
  gc.count::NUMERIC / tt.total_count as fraction
FROM group_counts gc
JOIN type_totals tt ON gc.ordertypedist = tt.ordertypedist
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The fraction represents each (translink, ordertypedist) group's count divided by the total count of all groups with that same ordertypedist value.
